metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2008 · The Color of Magic
metas.description: A cowardly wizard is roped into a life of adventure. A tale from the first two books of Terry Pratchett's fantasy series "Discworld".

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2026 · Tenzing
metas.description: The untold and inspiring tale of one of the most important mountain climbers in history who, with Edmund Hillary, became the first person to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

metas.name: 2026 · Whalefall
metas.description: Follows a scuba diver who, while looking for his father's remains, is swallowed by an 80-foot, 60-ton sperm whale and has just one hour to get out before his oxygen runs out.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2026 · Tomb Raider King
metas.description: God-like tombs surface globally, granting magical relics. Betrayed and left for dead, elite hunter Jooheon travels 15 years into the past to loot every tomb, hoard artifacts, and execute revenge.

metas.name: ★ 4.6 · 2010 · Yogi Bear
metas.description: A documentary filmmaker travels to Jellystone Park to shoot a project and soon crosses paths with Yogi Bear, his sidekick Boo-Boo and Ranger Smith.
